note: THE EVENTS' fixed ids and sizes (docs/vip.md), read by src/net/suitcase.ts, functions/checker/build.rs and tools/server/make-config.mts. The events (30 levels and 10 items each, one item hidden in each of 10 levels), their tables and items are Levels' (src/content/levels/events.json). Every other id is name-based (make-config's uuid5): an item 'suitcase:item:<item id>', an event's prize mark 'suitcase:prize:<event id>' (it is also the event's Passport stamp), an event's table 'table:<slug>' (src/net/tables.json). An id never changes once uploaded. `finds` is the progression each item found adds one to, which pays `coins` Coins with it (the creator, 2026-11-10: 15 with each item, 150 an event, was 50 and 500; paid as the items land: the platform pays at most 100 in one grant); a full suitcase pays its table and its stamp, and no helpers (VIPs have them free). `event` is the old monthly Arcade challenge, declared and written by nothing now; `spares`, `stack` and `shelf` are kept from the two-week events and read by nothing; `builtInTable` is every player's own table, which is no item, so an event showing it (a stand-in) pays no table. `on` is THE EVENTS' SWITCH, and on means ON FOR EVERYONE (the creator, 2026-11-10: VIP gates no content): while it is false no player sees an event (src/ui), and the checker refuses an event level (events_off) and pays no item, Coins or prize. A function cannot read the game config, so the switch is this file, compiled into the checker. functions/checker/tests/suitcase.rs holds the shipped value.
